q: True or false: A dialysis station is 2.00 m × 3.00 m.
n: 2 × 3 = 6. Remember this: a dialysis station is a "2 × 3 = 6" box. Water treatment room 12–15 sq. m. Treatment room door 1.12 m (3'-8"), better a 1.80 m pair. 24°C (75°F) and 6 air changes. Windows = 10% of floor area. Word root: hemodialysis = Greek haima "blood" + dialysis "separating".
